avis.titre: Buying this product for several years now
avis.texte: Love this product. My face feels so smooth after using it. Not harsh at all
I love this scrub and it has become my new fave! Scrubby enough to buff away dead skin and dirt, but gentle enough to use daily. It has done wonders for my acne prone and sensitive skin!
It's a nice scrub. I gave it 4 out of five because I think it's a bit overpriced.

I received this as a sample and found that it was a little too harsh. My face actually hurt and started to flake so much immediately after using. However I will say that at the time when I used this, my skin was damaged and sensitive to certain products. My skin is much happier now but if you have sensitive skin I wouldn't recommend. Instead MB has a more gentle Strawberry or Kiwi Exfoliating Scrub that I currently use and it's amazing!
Within the first week of use my skin was smoother and the color more even. The difference it has made in a short time has been fairly dramatic. I can see myself using it for life.
Absolutely love this. I got it as a sample in a package from Mario Badescu and loved it so much I've bought the full size twice now. Gentle but effective and so wonderful!

Amazing at removing dead skin cells and smoothing out your skin. I actually mix it with Mario Badescu's Glycolic Foaming Cleanser for the perfect mix. I truly feel that it has also kept wrinkles at bay. I have used this exfoliating scrub for years and hope that it is never discontinued!

avis.titre: A little drying. Gets the job done though. :)
avis.texte: This exfoliant can be pretty drying but I combat this by using a moisturizing cleanser and serum. Other than that, this product leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. Wouldn't recommend for extremely dry skin though.

I use this product once a week to exfoliate my face, neck, chest, and back. It is very gentle and does not irritate my sensitive skin. My skin feels very smooth and refreshed. My boyfriend uses it too and enjoys it. Great product, would highly recommend trying it out. Price is fair. This brand has never failed me.

I love this product. The fragrance is wonderful. I use it in the shower every other day. It keeps my face and neck smooth and soft. I love that it is an exfoliant and cleanser in one. I only have to buy one product, which is a huge saving to me.
I've been using this about once a week. I have sensitive skin and this has worked well for me.

This is my fourth time coming back to purchase. I have oily skin and would break out here and there. Ever since I started using this, my face has ALWAYS been clear now!! If I feel a small pimple forming, I apply this and the pimple just vanishes in like a couple days!! This also cleared my scarring from those few pimples I would always have before using this!! I hope this never gets discontinued.
I absolutely love this!! I use it daily and I can tell a difference in my skin.. + leaves your skin feeling amazing and soft.
I like the way this makes my skin feel - smooth and soft. It has a gentle exfoliation, and I think I might prefer a rougher scrub. It smells great. The texture is like a gel. I enjoy this product.

I only recently started really getting into taking better care of my skin and let me tell you, it has absolutely paid off. But anyway - this exfoliating scrub is one of the reasons my skin is better than it's ever been. I use this 2-3 times a week and it makes my skin so smooth. Worth every penny because since you aren't using it daily, it lasts ages. Highly recommend. Love this scrub SO much.

It was recommended to me to use this 2-3 times a week; I had to pare it down to once a week because it was causing my sensitive combination skin to break out with deep painful zits. The last 2 weeks I've been out of this exfoliate, and honestly, I haven't missed it. My skin does need a good exfoliation, but I don't think I'll purchase this again. It was too harsh for me, and I haven't had but one bad zit in the 2 weeks I've not been using it (and using this wouldn't have prevented that because it's on my neck under my jaw). It will work well for others; but I'm looking for something else instead.
I use this product about 2x a week or whenever I feel I need a deep clean. Gentle on my older skin and leaves a smooth foundation.
Love this face wash SO much. Smells fresh and clean and amazing. Leaves my skin feeling and looking wonderful. I usually have very sensitive skin and this has worked wonderfully.

I was looking for an exfoliant to scrub off blackheads and dry skin, while helping to provide moisture. An Ulta staff member recommended this product together with the Enzyme cleansing gel. This scrub isn't harsh but definitely gets the job done. When paired with the cleansing gel, my face is full of moisture and feels so refreshed!

I have sensitive skin/ combination to oily skin and this is the best face scrub ever! I absolutely love it, and after one use my skin was smoother. I have used it a couple of times and my skin texture I basically completely smooth. So thankful I found this. This is a miracle in a bottle!

I had high expectations for this scrub because all of the positive reviews and price. Although it works, right after you use it I recommend to put on a very hydrating moisturizer. I failed to do this once and my skin became very dry and flaky. Since my skin is already really dry the scrub just stripped the little oil that was there. So U recommend only buying this product if you have combo/oily skin.
I've been using this scrub for nearly 2 years and always comes through, helping to prevent and quickly clear breakouts

avis.titre: I've been using this one religiously
avis.texte: I have been using this for several years now and decided to write a review as I re-order. I tend to break out if I don't exfoliate somewhat regularly, and this is the best exfoliant I've tried. I've tried ones that are more like a cream cleanser with beads and I don't care for those. This formula is exactly what my skin responds to and I would recommend to others as well.

Everything Mario Badescu is fantastic. I like the thick, gel-like consistency of this scrub. Not as gritty as other scrubs I've tried but that's probably a good thing. Smells great, not too strong. I'd buy again!

Love the way this washes away my dead skin without being too harsh. You can feel the exfoliating beads working into the skin and a little bit goes a long way. I will continue to purchase. It's a must-have for me for the winter months. I am impressed.
I've used many mario products but this is my favorite! You can feel the results immediately - I use a couple times a week - you do have to be gentle when scrubbing or it can be harsh!

I use this after cleansing my skin, I only use it 2-3 times a week but I've definitely noticed that my skin is a lot smoother and softer than before. I was using a facial exfoliating scrub from L'Oréal and it wasn't doing much for my skin. I tend to get texture on the higher areas of my cheeks and on my forehead and after using this stuff the texture is practically gone!
I love this. It doesn't irritate my skin. It gives a gentle exfoliate. It leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed.
This scrub is amazing!! I could tell a difference after the first use...my skin was smoother and brighter...will definitely be a part of my skincare routine.

I can immediately tell the difference in my skin when I use this product! I love it so much. It leaves my skin so soft and incorporating it into my skin routine has made my skin feel and look so much better. I have combo skin that is acne prone.
I use this every-time im in the shower. My face has never looked and felt better. This has cleared up so much of my blemishes. Smells great and it's a great soft scrub, not rough on skin.
I really love how gentle this is. Not only can you use it on your face, but it works great on the body too. I love using it during the summer.
I love this scrub. It's so gentle and effective. I can notice my acne scars fading, definitely recommend.
Good scrub, decided to splurge on this one. It does the job but $13 would be a more reasonable price. It doesn't transform your skin.
Great for exfoliating and clearing sensitive, acne prone skin

I actually got this in a gift set for christmas, and i absolutely love it! It's such a gentle exfoliant that when you use it, it doesn't feel like your hurting your skin like many others do. It is not harsh at all and leaves my skin feeling amazing - especially in combination with the face wash gel (i don't remember the name, sorry!). But i have never had an exfoliating scrub like this that makes my feel unbelievably smooth after i use it. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
i absolutely love this product it is so gentle yet it works WONDERS i used this once and immediately saw results it made my skin sooo soft and i love this!!

you only need to use a very small amount and when you start scrubbing be careful! these scrubbies are strong! Just what I needed for exfoliant and has made my dark spots deminish already after only a few uses. High quality stuff.

This is a very good, effective, yet gentle exfoliator. I use it a couple of times a week. It really helps smooth and soften. I use retinols, and this is gentle enough to remove the flakiness that retinols can cause. LOVE!

I've been using this for a few weeks now and so far it feels very refreshing on my skin. Gentle enough to use everyday as well. I've been pairing this with the acne cleanser since I had acne-prone skin! I love that it's affordable as does the job.

This is by far my favorite exfoliating facial wash EVERRR. I use it every other day, and it is great for my skin, personally. My roommate even bought it after trying mine out. It's not as harsh as your typical exfoliating wash, but it feels like you're really getting in there and cleaning your skin. I won't be repurchasing because I love to try a lot of different products from this brand, but if I ever run out of options, this will be my go to!

Ive been using this for probably over 4 years now and its never let me down. I used to have lots of texture and it got rid of that after a month or so of using 3 times a week. Its truly a great face scrub
It works amazing! I could see the difference on the first use. My skin looked brighter and felt softer. It's a soft scrub not too rough and has a subtle smell. Definitely would buy again!

I love Mario Badescu products. I started noticing my foundation looking weird on my face, I had very dry skin, I was told exfoliating would help. This stuff is amazing, after 1-2 uses I already felt my face feel so smooth and noticed my foundation going on a lot more smooth and no more dry spots on my face 😊 will be repurchasing

avis.titre: Love how smooth my face is !!!
avis.texte: Love how smooth it leaves my face every time yet it's gentle on it .

Got this as a free sample from Mario Badescu's website and I love it. It makes my skin feel so smooth. I just got another sample from Ulta and I'm thrilled. I would definitely buy a full size, but I'd wait for a sale.

avis.titre: So gentle and good! Definitely a holy grail
avis.texte: Got this in a sample size and loved it so much when I tried it! You only have to use a pea size and you don't have to scrub your face harshly with this product. Just scrub gently and you can feel the beads basically doing all the work for you. My dry skin felt so soft and renewed. Would definitely buy the full size and mark this as a holy grail product
Okay by far the best exfoliating scrub I've used! A little goes a long way.
I love it! I love that it's not a really rough scrub across my face. It's still exfoliating but it's gentle.
I use this product daily even though it recommends 2 to 3 times a week. It's not harsh and doesn't over dry my skin. The only downside is it's a little pricey, but worth it.

This is the best scrub I have ever had. It works so well and takes all the dead skin cells off your face. You only have to use a pea size amount and it goes a long way. After I use it my face feels soooooo soft! Definitely get this scrub, it is well worth the money!
I use it twice a week and it leaves my skin feeling wonderful

I use prescription-strength topical acne meds which leave my skin DRY and flakey. so I use this once a week to lightly exfoliate and it works wonders without drying my skin out even more. smells therapeutic and works great.
This scrub leaves your skin feeling great. best feeling in the world lol I just love it. I'm so ready to try all Mario basescu products!
Love this product! Seems to be expensive , but it seriously last forever

My skin isn't too problematic, but pretty sensitive; this was gentle enough to use regularly, with no irritation. This is literally a godsend and I could tell the difference in my skin. I use it 2-3 times weekly, and my skin is so polished and blemish free. This is one of my holy grail skin care products!

avis.titre: Best facial scrub I've ever tried!
avis.texte: This stuff is amazing. It's finely ground and really exfoliates amazingly. It smells wonderful and leaves my skin smooth and brighter. I've tried so many exfoliators and this is one of the very best for my skin. I use three times a week and it has made a big difference in my skin.

avis.titre: This one is a winner! CRUELTY FREE!!
avis.texte: I love this product! I have sensitive skin and this product is perfect for it. I used it during the winter, the spring and now the summer. I agree that a little goes a long way. I'm in love with this product, and also LOVE THAT'S IT IS CRUELTY FREE!

For a long time since teen I used an Apricot scrub that was really grainy and I felt it got my skin clean and removed the dull skin but it was just ok. I started making my own scrub with sugar and other ingredients and also thought it was ok. I bought this for the 21 days of Beauty at half price. I love the smell. Its not rough or grainy but its just enough to do its job and leave me with nice skin. I feel like my face glows after. Definitely a keeper.

I got a small one of these in a trial kit. This feels kind of slimy when it goes on and doesn't seem to do anything in terms of exfoliation. Not planning on buying anything else by this brand. They make it look botanical and organic but it's all full of chemicals and none of their products I have tried have done anything for me.
I use mine in the shower and actually look forward to using it. Only 3x per week as directed but it seems as though it could be safe for everyday.
A little goes a long way with this exfoliator. Leaves skin feeling smooth, refreshed, and luminous.

i bought this product last year when the brand was on sale during the love your skin event. I used up this whole tube and bought a new one during this years event. This product leaves my skin feeling so soft. Since it is an exfoliant i only use it once or twice a week. But i love the way this makes my skin feel!

avis.titre: Not the right product for me
avis.texte: I was out of my Boots No. 7 scrub (which I started using after L'Oreal stopped selling their excellent scrub and lotion combo), and my local Ulta was out of Boots, so I decided to try something new. I should have waited for a Boots restock. My skin did not feel clean or exfoliated. This might be a good choice for someone with dry or sensitive skin, but it did nothing for me. If you want to try it, see if they will let you take a sample squeeze from the tester. You don't need much. Trying it on your hand is just not good test.

avis.titre: Smells great and a little goes a long way!
avis.texte: Really enjoying this exfoliating scrub so far! The light fragrance is nice and I think it gets the job of exfoliating done very well :) A little goes a long way I have found, so you don't have to squeeze out half the tube every time you use it, which is great because it airs on the pricey side in my humble opinion.
This product is amazing for my acne/oily prone skin. It leaves my skin soft and glowing. Definitely recommend and will continue to purchase.

I was disappointed with this because although I liked how it felt in my face, I'm pretty sure it broke me out. Anything that potentially exacerbates my already acne prone skin is a no go for me. It also dried me out a lot and I'm very oily. This didn't give any kind of glow or positive traits I need with an exfoliation. I have difficult skin so it might just not be for me.

avis.titre: Not too rough on my skin!
avis.texte: A lot of exfoliating scrubs I've used have been really rough on skin and feels likes its scratching me. This is not that! It was gentle yet got the job done, made my skin feel soft and clean. I'm so glad I tried this out!
This exfoliator is so gentle i can use it everyday to keep my skin clear and soft

I love this scrub because the exfoliating granules are five enough to smooth the surface of the skin, but not irritate it. I have a hormonal disorder called PCOS, so I get the hair that grows on my upper lip, chin, and neck waxed every 3-4 weeks. Any other scrub I've used to exfoliate those areas caused irritation and ingrown hairs instead of preventing them like exfoliating should. And what's worse than being a woman that grows a beard? Being a woman with ingrown hair bumps that can't be waxed away, shaved away, or bleached. Even the girl that waxes my face commented on how much easier the hair comes up and out now. Finally I've found a scrub that smooths the surface of my skin and doesn't cause ingrown bumps. I'm sticking with this.
Tries the travel size first and really liked so I bought the full size and haven't regretted it.
Easy product to use. Can use in shower or at sink. Particles are small are easy to use as a scrub. Smell is nice.

I like that the microbeads or whatever exfoliant they put in the scrub wasn't harsh or irritating—it was finer grain. I was even able to use it on the parts of my face that I get waxed (PCOS) and it didn't cause bumps or ingrown hairs.

avis.titre: Never AGAIN; Beware Harsh Ingredients in this Product
avis.texte: I tried this because I wanted to lightly exfoliate my combination/oily skin once a week. Am I sorry that I tried this product. I read the label which states that this product is "for all skin types" and given the fact that the line is known for using natural ingredients and extracts, and had read the reviews, so I mistakenly believed this product is safe. Trust me, it is not! It's kind of greasy and takes a lot of rinsing to get this off your face. I splashed with cool water and gently used with only my fingertips in light circles on my entire face. Immediately, my face started burning, turning red in the areas where I'd applied the scrub. I freaked out and began splashing cool water and cold compresses only, but my face felt like it was scalded with angry red bumps everywhere. My skin was absolutely perfect before using this. All I was hoping for was to brighten in certain areas. There was nothing I could possibly have used to lessen the burn or to prepare me for this. Now, a full 4 days later my face has now started peeling, still feels hot and sensitive to even water, and I realize now that my face was burned by this product. I am afraid to put anything on since it's still healing. I did notice the red outline everywhere I had used this product. I have never written a review, but wanted other consumers to know that this product is not for everyone. Other reviewers had apparently had a bad experience. Before this, I'd only used the hydrating rose water, lavender water, cucu
I love this stuff! A little goes a long way. My face feels super soft and clean after washing my face with this. I then use Mario toner, face moisturizer, and eye moisturizer afterwards.

My daughter has a skin condition where her skin does not slough off on it's own. She is really enjoying this product to help exfoliate her dry skin without overly drying her new skin underneath. So far, she is really enjoying this product.
Doesn't dry out my skin like lots of other exfoliant do. Very gentle yet effective. Soothing and simple.
Great product, will definitely be keeping this is my skin care routine.
Love the feel of this gentle scrub. Not abrasive like other products.
Used this due to having some acne issues with my chin all of a sudden.....: it really exfoliated well and my skin in that area has started to clear up this week.
Was only going to use twice a week but my face felt and look so great so I would be using every day.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: So I happened to walk in on a day where they were doing the 21 days of beauty and this item was 1/2 off. I am always skeptical with buying new products, but I tried the kits and really like them. A little goes a long way, which is nice. The products is clear and has a grainy/gel feel. It does lather and it smells good. Smell is not overwhelming. I have an opposite T-zone (oily T zone and dry face), and this works really well for me. I just started using the product. I use it about twice per week.

I picked this up when it was on sale during the 21 days of beauty. I don't know why I haven't tried it before bc I love Mario products! This one did not disappoint. It removed all the little dry pieces of skin from my face during these cold winter months, and is superior to my drug store scrub. It will be a new staple of mine for sure!

So I don't have huge pores, but I definitely get blackheads on my nose and a few areas of my face. I purchased this product in a sample pack and I absolutely love it. My pores have shrunk and I no longer have blackheads. I have had blackheads since I was thirteen years old and I am 28. Nothing I have used has ever cleared them and shrunk my pores like this cleanser. I have also noticed and improvement in my skins texture overall; it is softer, less oily, and the tone is slightly more even. I use about 3 times a week.
This thing has sulfates in it, which are awful for your skin. It baffles me how these expensive brands put such terrible ingredients in their products.

this right here automatically makes my face feel clean and refreshed as soon as i wash it off. it says 30 seconds scrub and rinse. i can instantly feel cleanliness on my face . i love that its exfoliating but its not rough on the face. it wont harm your skin or cut you like some other exfoliators do. some other exfoliators leave your skin vulnerable but not this. dead skin off in 30 seconds. left with baby bottom soft face. if you follow up with their toner it works wonders.
Looking for a gentle scrib. I This product makes my face feel fabulous.

I just recently purchased this product and it is the best exfoliating scrub I have EVER used. You can feel it getting off the dirt and dead skin. It leaves your face feeling AMAZINGLY soft even after a couple days of using it. This product is definitely worth the buy.
Struggled with bad acne for years, I am in my early twenties right now & my skin has been clear for months until I started using this.. has been breaking me out :(
my daughter had beautiful clear skin until she used this product.

I have been on search for a good exfoliator to add into my routine. I read lots of reviews and finally gave this one a try. I'm so glad I did. It's great. Works like a heavy duty face scrub without leaving your face feeling like you used your kitchen scrubby to scrub it. I am so happy with this purchase.
I like it , it's not harsh like other facial scrubs . It smells great and it leaves your skin clean and smooth
This is such a great exfloliator! I just love that my skin feels so soft and so clean after using it!
I've use it twice a week to resurface my face...it leaves it really smooth and not dry al all
You only need a pea size amount and your skin will thank you!!
I use a combo of things along w this scrub. The mia, pore extractor by philosophy, and PTR facial peels. Loves how my skin feels after. I do rotate the products.
Love this product! Leaves my skin feeling sooooo smooth !!!! I've loved this product so much I got my friends and family to start using this product & brand

I have tried so many scrubs and this is by far the best. My skin feels and looks so clean and afterwards. The next morning my acne always goes down. The green tea extracts, coconut and aloe really make my skin glow!
Nothing about this is necessarily life-changing, but it is a nice basic exfoliating cleanser. I feel like it does a good job of removing makeup, dirt, and oil. My skin always feels nice after.
I will never use another scrub again. I tend to get very red and dry after most scrubs and washed but not with this. It's gentle but very effective. After one use I feel a difference.

I had extreme redness around my nose. After a month of not using this my face is still healing. Nothing in my routine changed so I know it was this.This literally scraped my skin away. I do NOT recommend for sensitive skin. Unless you have extremely oily skin maybe 1 time every 4 days then but other than that I would only use this for a pedicure to exfoliate legs NEVER a face.

I LOVE THIS!! I have sensitive combination skin with some dry flakey parts. I use a lot of makeup so my pores get easily clogged up and especially around the nostrils. I use this on a dry face, but with wet hands. I know you should have a wet face but I feel like it gets too gentle, I think exfoliators/scrubs should be a little rough, but not too rough otherwhise I feel like it doesn't do anything or not enough anyway. I get dry flakey skin, especially around blemishes and this gets rid of it. The same thing with the clogged pores around my nostrils. My face feels no clean and smooth after using this! I also believe it has cleared up my skin alot combined with the acne facial cleanser and the clinique moisture surge!

I absolutely love this product! I use this about 3 times a week on my face because I have combonation skin, it helps to clear dry skin off and helps open up my skin before a mask, and just generally helps with keeping acne away! I also use it to exfoliate when I shave, and it works wonders!! I have very sensitive skin when I shave so using this before hand gets rid of all bumps, and helps to get a cleaner shave

Love this!! I got a sample of it a while ago when I made a purchase of the face mist and fell in love. Love all of this lines products and most are moderately priced. This product is a little pricy for an exfoliator in my opinion but worth it. It lasts forever too you only need a small amount.

avis.titre: Loyal to MB but this isn't my fav
avis.texte: I love MB for the combo of performance and price and this falls short on price for me. I've purchased twice and I do like the scrub and think it performs well but I find I have to use more than other exfoliates and I go through it really quickly. Although it's more expensive, the philosophy exfoliator lasts forever. You only need a dime sized amount and can use it every day. Overall, it's a good scrub but doesn't match its value.

I use this 2 or 3 times a week to gently exfoliate my face and neck. I have a little seborreah and it takes the flakes away and moisturizes. I find my make up goes on smoother the day I use this. It is very gentle, has no odor, is very moisturizing.
